note: Desert Hot Springs, about 20 km from Palm Springs, is a town of dozens of mineral-water spa hotels fed by their own wells; the cooler months are the draw, summer is very hot.

note: Volcanic island with thermal baths and the Vulcano mud pools; reports conflict on whether the Sciacca and Acireale baths are open, so this is held at a mid score.
Acqui Terme (the Bollente spring at about 75 C, Terme di Acqui) and the Royal Baths of Valdieri in the Argentera park; cool months suit thermal bathing.
Therme Wien (Oberlaa) is a large city spa on thermal springs, 15 minutes by metro; Baden bei Wien is a second option. Winter is when thermal bathing is most sought.
Bullicame (free natural pools) and Terme dei Papi at Viterbo, about 90 km north of Rome; a day trip, so a mid-low score.
San Jacinto hervideros (boiling mud and fumaroles) beside Telica volcano, 30 minutes from Leon; the dry season is better.
Thermal-water parks and spas within about 100 to 135 km: Agua Hedionda (Cuautla) and Ixtapan de la Sal; day trips from the city.
Caldas de Aregos on the Douro (water at 62 C) plus the Vidago, Pedras Salgadas and Chaves spa towns further north-east.
No springs on the coast itself; the thermal island of Ischia (Poseidon Gardens) is a ferry ride from Naples.

note: Atotonilco hot springs (Santiago Jamiltepec) and the mineral pools of Hierve el Agua; the springs are far from the city, so a low score.
Hin Dat hot springs in Kanchanaburi province (pools at 40 to 50 C) are a long day trip from Bangkok; cool season is better.
Isola 2000, Auron and Valberg are about 90 minutes inland (91 ski lifts mapped inside the area); ski in the morning and sit on the coast in the afternoon.
Mont Serein and Chalet-Reynard on Mont Ventoux have a few small lifts that run only in snowy years (19 lifts mapped).
Ober Gatlinburg is a small ski area above the park gateway town (16 lifts mapped); it makes snow, season about December to March.
Mount Wilhelm (4,509 m) is the country's standard climb; 50 peaks above 3,000 m mapped; the drier months June to September are best.
Whole country: Hkakabo Razi (5,881 m) in the far north is the highest peak in Southeast Asia, climbed only by rare expeditions; the cool dry season is the likely window.

Whole country includes Cabarete, one of the best-known kitesurfing and windsurfing towns in the world (15 schools listed); strongest wind about June to August, a second window December to April, weakest September to November.
Paros and Naxos in the Cyclades are known for meltemi windsurfing and kiting (Pounda, Golden Beach); season about May to October, best June to September; windy on 56% of days at the coast.
Kite and windsurf schools listed at Lagos, Sagres and Tavira (3 mapped); summer northerly winds.
Zandvoort, IJmuiden and the IJsselmeer lakes have schools (4 mapped); a long season, strongest in autumn and spring.
Whole of Wales: Rhosneigr on Anglesey and Gower and Pembrokeshire beaches have schools (4 mapped).
Several resorts and islands run kite seasons in the northeast monsoon; windy on 40% of days.
Kite schools run in the southeast trade winds, about May to October; windy on 48% of days.
Kite schools around Tulum and Playa del Carmen (3 mapped); winter northerlies and a summer sea breeze.
Kite schools at El Nido and Coron (3 mapped), mostly in the dry-season northeast winds.
Kite schools at Nai Yang and Mai Khao on Phuket run in the southwest monsoon (3 mapped).
The East Lothian coast (Gullane, Belhaven) is a known kite and windsurf area; windy on 31% of days.
The Athens Riviera has kite and windsurf schools (3 mapped) in the summer meltemi, a minor scene.
Windy on 68% of days at the coast but open Atlantic with no schools listed; ruled switched on by the owner.
Five schools are listed in the area, probably around the bays of Naples and Salerno; summer sea breeze.
1,142 historic sites, monuments and palaces listed across the Northeast (above the applicable median of 934): Ahom-era monuments around Sivasagar, Kamakhya and Majuli; cool dry season is best.
